target.statement: SynthBH achieves empirical power (detection rate) on the Shuttle outlier-detection benchmark comparable to or higher than BH(real) while keeping FDP near α=10% (Figure 1, Shuttle panel)
target.dataset: Shuttle (UCI/OpenML), n=500 inliers, N=2500 contaminated synthetic samples, m=1000 test points

compute.basis: Shuttle is ~58k rows x 9 features; Isolation Forest (100 trees) plus conformal p-values and SynthBH over 100 random splits is pure CPU sklearn work, a few minutes per split at most.

blockers: Code repo may not include exact configs/scripts for the Shuttle figure; may need to reimplement the trimming + conformal pipeline from Appendix D.1
100 random splits needed to match reported averages
title: Synthetic-Powered Multiple Testing with FDR Control
